reason: Provides configurable multi-provider fallback for same-named models, routing agent requests through an ordered provider chain and failing over after terminal errors or exhausted retries.

summaries.zh: 为同名模型配置有序的多提供商链路，在请求失败或重试耗尽后自动切换到后备提供商。
summaries.en: Configures ordered provider chains for same-named models and automatically fails over to the next provider after terminal errors or exhausted retries.

capabilities: Routes model requests through ordered provider fallback pools
Retries requests by advancing to the next configured provider after terminal failures
Validates provider and model route availability before streaming
Records provider-level failures and aggregates errors when all providers are exhausted
